newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Growing areas miss rain, snow.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Growing areas miss rain, snow.

text.p: Most of western Kansas, western Oklahoma and eastern Colorado failed to receive any precipitation during the last 24 hours, dealers said Tuesday.
Dealers had been optimistic Monday that rain or snow would help alleviate dry topsoil conditions.
"We didn't get anything," said a dealer in Wichita, "I heard there was some spotty rain up north, with northeast Kansas getting the greatest amount."
Dealers said winds of 30 to 40 miles per hour were expected Tuesday in western Kansas, raising the prospect of unwanted soil movement.
"I talked to a couple of guys out in eastern Colorado who said there was a lot of dirt blowing out there yesterday, and it's headed our way today," a Kansas dealer said.
Basis bids were steady to weaker and movement was extremely slow Monday, dealers said.
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
(Note: H=KCBT March wheat futures. unq- unquoted, na - not applicable)
